name: forest-admin-ai
description: AI skills and tools for Forest Admin

plugins.name: forest
plugins.description: ★ Main plugin — build a Forest Admin back-office headlessly from Claude, no UI. Start with /forest:start. Covers onboarding, layout & workspaces, workflows, and project management (roles/users/teams/environments/deploy). Orchestrates the toolbelt CLI end-to-end.

plugins.name: forest-code
plugins.description: Write and maintain Forest Admin agent code (modern + legacy): actions, fields, hooks, segments, charts, relationships. Pairs with `forest`.

plugins.name: forest-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server skill for querying and manipulating Forest Admin data (list/search/create/update/delete records, explore schemas).

plugins.name: forest-docs
plugins.description: Ask anything about Forest Admin — connects to the docs MCP server.
